verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at doc.anytype.io (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as raw .md pages, which an agent can ingest directly. The anytype-ts repo also ships an AGENTS.md, and there are agent-oriented skill docs for Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms.txt or llms-full.txt for the developer/API portal (developers.anytype.io), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
